verdict.stance: Neutral / Poland's #1 Bank with Waning CHF Legal Drag & 19% ROE (A2 / A-)
verdict.summary: PKO BP posted PLN 8.22bn 9M26 net profit with 19.0% ROE, 31.0% cost-to-income, and ultra-low 27-30bps cost of risk as CHF mortgage legal provisions dropped sharply to PLN 1.1bn (vs PLN 4.4bn in FY25). Strong 15.28% Tier 1 ratio underpins tight IG MREL/Tier 2 spreads.

positives: Poland's #1 universal bank (~$162.3bn assets) with 29.4% Polish State Treasury ownership.
Exceptional efficiency (31.0% C/I, 19.0% ROE) and pristine 27-30bps cost of risk in 9M26.
CHF mortgage legal provisioning declining rapidly (PLN 1.1bn in 9M26 vs PLN 4.4bn FY25).
negatives: Polish bank windfall/CIT tax rates and sensitivity to NBP rate cuts.
Ongoing MREL debt issuance supply in EUR.
Direct linkage to Poland sovereign credit ceiling, local policy rate cycles, and FX volatility.
